articles.title: Serbian police shoot dead assailant at Israeli Embassy
articles.summary: A "minor" has been killed by police after attacking a guard at Israel's embassy in Belgrade with knives, the interior minister says. Ivica Dacic said police had declared the highest terror alert after the incident.

articles.title: Serbia raises terror threat after attack on elite guard at Israeli Embassy
articles.summary: Serbian police killed a minor armed with two knives who attacked an elite-unit officer guarding the Israeli Embassy in Belgrade, AP reported, citing police. Interior Minister Ivica Dacic said police had raised the terror threat to the highest level. The attack came days after Serbia’s early parliamentary election, and Israel held its own vote Tuesday, with exit polls showing no clear winner.
